clues.it: Elena era nella 1ª riga, a nord di Irene e nella Sala del Trono.
clues.en: Elena was in the 1st row, north of Irene and in the Throne Room.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 8ª colonna, accanto a una botte e in una stanza diversa da Anna.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 8th column, beside an ale barrel and in a different room from Anna.

clues.it: Marta era nella 3ª riga, accanto a un tappeto e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Marta was in the 3rd row, beside a rug and west of Vito.

clues.it: Carla era nella 15ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Anna.
clues.en: Carla was in the 15th column, in the 4th row and in a different room from Anna.

clues.it: Irene era nella 12ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Irene was in the 12th column and in the same room as Dario.

clues.it: Nino era in una stanza diversa da Paolo e nelle Cucine.
clues.en: Nino was in a different room from Paolo and in the Kitchens.

clues.it: Vito era nella 7ª riga, accanto a un trono e a nord di Bruno.
clues.en: Vito was in the 7th row, beside a throne and north of Bruno.

clues.it: Dario era seduto su una sedia e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Dario was sitting on a chair and north of Anna.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 7ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e da solo nella Cappella.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 7th column, in the 9th row and alone in the Chapel.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una torcia e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Luca was beside a torch and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Ugo era a ovest di Anna e in Biblioteca.
clues.en: Ugo was west of Anna and in the Library.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 12ª riga, accanto a delle catene e a un trono.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 12th row, beside loose chains and a throne.

clues.it: Olga era nella 4ª colonna, nella 13ª riga e a ovest di Sergio.
clues.en: Olga was in the 4th column, in the 13th row and west of Sergio.

clues.it: Tea era nella 10ª colonna, accanto a una torcia e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Tea was in the 10th column, beside a torch and west of Carla.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 6ª colonna e accanto a uno sgabello, ma non era accanto a della paglia.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 6th column and beside a stool, but was not beside a bed of straw.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.it: L'indizio di Carla lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 15ª.
steps.en: Carla's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 15th.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 8ª riga.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 8th row.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 13ª colonna.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 13th column.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 7ª colonna: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 13ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 7th column: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 8th, column 13th.

steps.en: Sergio can only be in the 12th row: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 14th, column 10th.

steps.en: Olga can only be in the 13th row: ruling it out leaves Rosa a single square: row 2nd, column 8th.

steps.en: Olga can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 3rd, column 2nd.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 16ª colonna.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 16th column.

steps.it: Escludendo la 8ª riga di Dario, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 12ª.
steps.en: Ruling out Dario's 8th row leaves Irene a single square: row 5th, column 12th.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 5ª colonna: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 1st, column 1st.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 3ª colonna, e lì a Ugo resta una sola casella libera: la 11ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 3rd column, and it leaves Ugo a single free square there: the 11th row.
